title: ODNI nine-month operation against whistleblowers and journalists

tellings.quote: I just want you to know that ODNI ran an operation for 9 months.

plain: The Office of the Director of National Intelligence, which oversees all the US spy agencies, ran a nine-month operation aimed at UFO whistleblowers and journalists, according to Jeremy Corbell, who reports on the subject and says he was caught up in it. "I just want you to know that ODNI ran an operation for 9 months," he tells Michels, and in telling it he names the journalist George Knapp, the whistleblowers Dylan Borland and Matthew Brown, the intelligence director Tulsi Gabbard, and a body he calls the Directors Initiative Group. If true, it would mean the intelligence agencies were working against the very people bringing UFO claims to light.
